definitions.full: H8495. tayish [ תַּ֫יִשׁ ] noun masculine he-goat (Late Hebrew id. ; Arabic Aramaic תֵּישָׁא תְּיָשָׁא, id. , √ unknown); — absolute תָּ֑יִשׁ Prov 30:31 ; plural תְּיָשִׁים Gen 30:35 (J), 32:15 (E; + עִזִּים she-goats ), 2Chr 17:11 . תֹּךְ see תכך . below.
